messages:
maya: Proposal — add a small "Route to v1" toggle/button in the Console per-API-key row so support and SRE can repro legacy-client issues without changing tenant routing.

devon: 👍 love the idea for debugging. main concerns: quota accounting and accidental user-visible routing.

claire: Agree. Also need telemetry flags so we don't pollute v1 telemetry when it's just a support repro.

tariq: Suggestion: make it a soft action that requires a reason and expires after 30m. record in audit log. (we did similar for feature-flips)

maya: +1 on expiry. UX sketch: small kebab menu on key -> "Route requests to: [default] [v1 - temp] [v2]". Clicking v1 opens modal: reason (required), duration (default 30m), notify owner checkbox.

sam: Implementation notes: runtime routing supports header override already: `X-Redwood-Api-Version: v1`. We can map Console action to inject that header for requests made from Console or create a proxy token shim.

tariq: If we inject header from Console, ensure the request path and auth are identical so we hit same caches/kvs. Otherwise results might differ and repro fails.

devon: Quota model: should routed-to-v1 calls count against the tenant's standard quota or a separate "debug" bucket? I prefer standard so quotas reflect real-world cost; but we should surface a transient meter in Console so non-admins see the extra usage.

claire: Telemetry: annotate all routed requests with `console_route_override=true` and `override_source=console` and `override_duration=30m`. That lets us filter out repros in long-term metrics and still see short-term effects.

product-led: From a product POV — make it opt-in for orgs (tenant setting) and add Guardrails: only allowed by members in the "support" or "sre" role. Also show a banner if anything is proxied to v1 in production routes.

infra-bot: deploybot: routing-proxy:branch=feature/console-route-toggle deployed to staging at 1750001250 (pipeline #4821)

maya: Next steps: PR for Console UX (mock + e2e stub), backend flag to allow header injection for console tokens, telemetry + audit entries, and a short playbook section for Support. I'll own the Console PR. @tariq can you scope backend and quota changes?

tariq: I can. I'll post an RFC sketch in a separate thread with the quota/usage implications and proposed audit schema.

sam: quick dev tip in the RFC: small curl to reproduce: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -H "X-Redwood-Api-Version: v1" -d '{"input":"hi"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v2/generate` — hits the v1 codepath when routing allows header overrides.

devon: One more — add rate-limited guard so console-triggered v1 routing can't be used to bypass v2 rate limits accidentally (e.g., debugging loops). enforce per-user short cap.

maya: Good call. I'll add to issue. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
thread_text_snippet: Proposal — add a small Route to v1 toggle/button in the Console per-API-key row so support and SRE can repro legacy-client issues without changing tenant routing.
